document.title: Objednávka

i18n.i18nString: Filled in automatically when the order is created. The right to see one's own order hangs on this list.
What exactly is to be ordered. The total drives who has to approve.
Source of truth for the list. Nobody edits it by hand.
Adds the line to the list and recalculates the total.
Tick what should go; then press Remove ticked.
Removes every ticked line and recalculates the total.
Total of the requirements. Decides who has to approve: above the limit the director approves too.
Whose budget the order is charged to.
Who has the order on their desk right now. Names, so it reads the same in every language.
The requester sees it on the order. Every note is kept in Progress.
The number the supplier was given. The invoice refers to it later.
What happened to the order. Appended automatically; it cannot be overwritten.
Multiplicity of a variable arc. The decision action sets it; nobody edits it by hand.
Filled in automatically from the cost centre when the order is submitted. The right to approve hangs on this list.

document.function: { def kod -> def m = ["koncept" : "grey", "na_schvalenie": "blue", "u_riaditela" : "indigo", "na_objednanie": "teal", "objednana" : "green", "vratena" : "orange", "zamietnuta" : "red"] return m[kod as String] ?: "grey" }
{ def ob_suma -> def v = ob_suma.value if (v == null) return "price not filled in" return String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%.2f", (v as Number).doubleValue()) + " €" }

{ def kod -> def k = ((kod ?: "") as String) if (k == "na_schvalenie") return "The order is awaiting cost centre approval." if (k == "u_riaditela") return "The order is above the limit and awaits the director's approval." if (k == "na_objednanie") return "The order is approved - it can be placed." if (k == "objednana") return "The order was placed with the supplier." if (k == "vratena") return "The order was returned for completion." if (k == "zamietnuta") return "The order was rejected." return "The order is a draft." }

data.title: Schvaľovatelia strediska
data.desc: Vyplní sa sám pri podaní podľa strediska. Na tomto zozname visí právo objednávku schváliť.

data.title: Žiadal (užívateľ)
data.desc: Vyplní sa sám pri založení objednávky. Na tomto zozname visí právo vidieť vlastnú objednávku.

data.title: Požiadavky (dáta)
data.desc: Zdroj pravdy zoznamu. Ručne sa needituje.

data.title: Požiadavky
data.desc: Čo presne treba objednať. Podľa súčtu sa určuje, kto musí schvaľovať.
Pridá riadok do zoznamu a prepočíta súčet.

data.title: Odobrať zo zoznamu
data.desc: Zaškrtnite, čo má zo zoznamu zmiznúť, a stlačte Odobrať vybrané.
Odoberie všetky zaškrtnuté riadky a prepočíta súčet.

data.title: Predpokladaná cena s DPH (€)
data.desc: Súčet požiadaviek. Rozhoduje o tom, kto musí schvaľovať: nad limit schvaľuje aj riaditeľ.

data.title: U koho leží
data.desc: Kto má objednávku práve na stole. Sú to mená, aby to bolo rovnaké v každom jazyku.

data.title: Poznámka k objednávke
data.desc: Zadávateľ ju uvidí na objednávke. Každá poznámka zostáva v Priebehu.

data.title: Číslo objednávky
data.desc: Číslo, ktoré dostal dodávateľ. Faktúra sa naň potom odvoláva.

data.title: Priebeh
data.desc: Čo sa s objednávkou dialo. Dopĺňa sa samo, prepísať sa nedá.
